standard_prerequisites: Same chapter: lemma-separable-degree ([E : F]_s = |Mor_F(E, F-bar)|), lemma-characterize-normal (normality iff all F-embeddings into an algebraic closure have the same image)
core_obligations: Inequality: fixing sigma_0 in Mor_F(E, F-bar), the map tau -> sigma_0 circ tau from Aut(E/F) to Mor_F(E, F-bar) is injective, so |Aut(E/F)| <= [E : F]_s
Equality implies normal: every F-embedding is sigma_0 composed with an automorphism, so sigma(E) = sigma_0(E) for all sigma, which is normality by lemma-characterize-normal
Normal implies equality: sigma(E) = sigma_0(E) for all sigma, so tau = sigma_0^{-1} circ sigma is an F-automorphism of E, making the displayed map surjective
proof_roadmap: Inject the automorphism group into the embedding set
Run both directions of the equality through the equal-images criterion
